name: Ketesa
description: Ketesa (formerly Synapse Admin) is a mobile-friendly admin UI for Matrix homeservers. Manage users, rooms, media, reports and registration tokens on Synapse, with full Matrix Authentication Service (MAS) support. Drop-in replacement for Synapse Admin.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Optional Ketesa configuration file (e.g. restrictBaseUrl). Must exist as a file before the first start - '{}' is a valid empty config.
